## The load-bearing one

**P-04.** Everything in `Price_Recommendation.md` rests on Scenario B being
outside the market. One contract above ₹5 lakh would falsify it and reopen the
question Phase 7 set aside. It is also the single easiest of the six to test —
it requires one signature, not a research programme.

## How many of these are testable today

None, without field contact. One (P-04) needs a signed contract; the rest need
interviews that have not been conducted. That is the state of this phase, stated
plainly rather than buried.
